category_title: Resistant eleventh grader with behavioral history and workplace-centered identity
minimal_context: Derek is working on an independent reading assignment in the classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please go ahead and read this text independently, and let me know when you are finished with the section.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Slouches in his chair and quickly flips to the end of the pages) I'm done. I finished it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: That was very fast. What was the passage about?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know. My eyes just seem to skip over words as I’m going down the page.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to go back to the beginning and try reading it again so you can understand the meaning.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Crosses his arms) It makes me feel like I do not want to read anymore. This is really boring. I really want to leave.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please go ahead and read this text independently, and let me know when you are finished with the section.

TUTOR: You need to go back to the beginning and try reading it again so you can understand the meaning.

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When students struggle with decoding, fluency, or skipping words during independent reading/testing.
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Instead of persevering through the text, such as rereading in order to make meaning, he would just skip words or lines in order to continue and finish the task presented.
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Feeling like he does not want to read anymore, finding it really boring, wanting to leave.
related_quotes: My eyes just seem to skip over words as I’m going down the page.
Reading makes me feel like ...I don’t know ...sometimes it makes me feel like good and other times it makes me feel like I do not want to read anymore. This is really boring. I really want to leave.

behavior_patterns.condition: When reading independently or taking tests
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Skips words or lines in order to continue and finish the task presented
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Struggled with speech and decoding words
related_quotes: I somehow just skip over words on tests and then like I’ll go back through and someone will read it to me and like I realize I never knew it said that.
